results.title: From Concept to Showcase - K/DA FIRESTARTER Behind The Scenes | Fortiche Chit Chat
results.original_title: From Concept to Showcase - K/DA FIRESTARTER Behind The Scenes | Fortiche Chit Chat
results.overview: Six years later, K/DA makes their fiery return.  From early sketches to the seamless final take, discover how the team reimagined the fashion runway as a living, breathing musical score.  In this exclusive interview, Fortiche Creative Director Marietta Ren storyboarders Benjamin Warnitz & Joséphine Meis take us behind the scenes of Firestarter to explore how our team brought the concept for K/DA's long-awaited comeback to life.

results.title: Ominous
results.overview: When Jake begins noticing something unnatural in the darkness during a sleepover, his friend Damien refuses to believe him, leaving Jake alone with a growing sense that something is terribly wrong.

results.title: Low-Hanging Fruit
results.overview: A trans woman discovers a mysterious pair of artefacts and tries to sell them on the black market, hoping to escape her past. Meanwhile, a consciousness waits for a body to inhabit.

results.title: The Trench
results.overview: Driven by a fading love and apocalyptic anguish, porn director Bielohusky embarks on a journey to the deepest part of the ocean, the Mariana Trench. Accompanied by a team of old and new friends, he comes to realize that the expedition is more difficult than he expected, with tension mounting as they descend.

results.title: It’s Not Sweet
results.overview: Eleven-year-old Hong and his sister are only allowed to eat watermelon the day before his birthday buffet—a family tradition that is increasingly difficult to uphold amid strife.

results.title: Border
results.overview: A teenager, Achi, who is in the forest with his friend, suddenly finds himself alone. While searching for his friend, he gradually loses his sense of spatial orientation and ends up in an environment that becomes increasingly unfamiliar and uncertain. The forest slowly ceases to be merely a physical location and transforms into a space of inner experience, where reality, time, and perception begin to blur and intertwine.

results.title: GTA, le jeu no limit
results.overview: As GTA 6, the most anticipated video game in history, launches worldwide in November 2026, explore the story of Grand Theft Auto, a franchise that has evolved from a target of political and media backlash into a global pop culture phenomenon. After three decades of redefining gaming through its open worlds and unprecedented freedom, what does GTA's enduring success reveal beyond the controversy and high-speed chases?

results.overview: Agathe, married with two children, receives a text message for Valentine's Day inviting her to a hotel room.

results.title: Everywhere
results.overview: A guy who just got dumped keeps seeing his ex everywhere he goes.

results.title: Rise and Shine
results.overview: Terri Steele has waited her whole life for high school. She wants what every teenager wants: new friends, a beautiful dress, a date to prom and the chance to be seen for exactly who she is. Her mother, Janice, has spent Terri’s whole life helping her believe the world can make room for her. Now they must discover what it means to let go, grow up and step into a new day.

results.title: The Man in The Mirror
results.overview: To Emma, her husband Jason’s death was a painful mystery. To the police, it was an open-and-shut suicide case. But to P.I. Alan Schmidt, it was a descent into madness he’s desperate to forget. Haunted by the memory of Jason’s frantic rants about a malevolent entity lurking in the mirror, Alan retraces Jason’s final hours.

results.title: Look Across The Water
results.overview: Five friends miss the last ferry off the Toronto Islands and try to wait out the night near the Gibraltar Point Lighthouse. A dead coyote, figures in the trees, and a cult drawn to the shoreline turn a familiar summer hang into a fight to survive until morning.
